skill.title: Coordinate plane
skill.promise: You can place a point on the plane.
skill.pipAbility: Pip can land on a point.

lessons.title: Place a point

screens.prompt: Drag the tip onto the mark.

feedback.wrong_direction: The mark sits up and to the right of the tail.
feedback.wrong_length: The aim is right. Stretch or shorten until the tip meets the mark.

screens.correctMessage: The tip is on the mark.

screens.prompt: The mark sits up and to the right. That means...

options.label: x and y are both positive
x is positive and y is negative

feedback.wrong_option: Up means y is positive. Right means x is positive.

screens.prompt: The mark is 2 right of x = 5. Set x.

feedback.too_low: Start at 5 and step right twice. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: Two steps right of 5 is not that far. Move lower.

screens.prompt: The same mark is 4 up from y = 1. Set y.

feedback.too_low: Start at 1 and climb 4. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: Four steps up from 1 is less than that. Move lower.

feedback.wrong_direction: 4 right and 3 up leaves the horizontal line.
feedback.wrong_length: The direction matches. The run is 4 and the rise is 3.

screens.correctMessage: The tip is the tail plus that move.

lessons.whyItMatters: A model stores a position as two numbers.

lessons.title: Read a point

feedback.wrong_option: Both numbers are zero, so the point sits where the axes cross.

screens.correctMessage: The origin is the crossing of the axes.

screens.prompt: Which pair is 2 right and 5 up?

feedback.wrong_option: (5, 2) is 5 right and 2 up. Right is the first number.

screens.correctMessage: Right is the first number. Up is the second.

screens.prompt: A point moves from x = 2 to x = 8. How many steps right?

feedback.too_low: The ends are farther apart. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The gap is the difference, not the larger end. Move lower.

screens.correctMessage: The mark is 6 steps right of where it started.

screens.prompt: That point's y went from 1 to 5. How many steps up?

feedback.too_low: The rise is larger than that. Move higher.
feedback.too_high: The rise is smaller than that. Move lower.

screens.prompt: From the tail at (1, 2), go 5 right and 1 up.

feedback.wrong_direction: The point sits up and to the right of the tail.
feedback.wrong_length: The run is 5 and the rise is 1.

lessons.whyItMatters: Swapping the two numbers sends a model to the wrong place.
